PORT.description: HTTP port Railway routes to. Railway injects this automatically.

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username for the /kanban-terminal/ web terminal (ttyd token auth).

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the /kanban-terminal/ web terminal (ttyd token auth).

HERMES_HOME.description: Root directory for all Hermes persistent state (boards, profiles, config). Mounted as a Railway volume.

HERMES_KANBAN_API_TOKEN.description: OPTIONAL bearer token. When set, all API requests (including the SSE stream) require 'Authorization: Bearer ***'. Leave empty to keep the board open.

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.description: Ollama API base URL. Auto-linked to the sibling Ollama service for local LLM inference.
